summary: The 'AssessmentCombined' document deals with handling assessments for students and instructors in a structured wizard-style interface, focusing on questions, answers, and associated logic for various assessment sections.
purpose: To provide a comprehensive framework for conducting assessments involving students and instructors, allowing for interim and final assessments, sectioned questions, and various input formats.

fields.name: templateCode
fields.description: String value representing the assessment template code.

fields.name: placementRequestDestinationID
fields.description: Integer representing the destination ID for a placement request.

fields.name: placementRequestAssessmentID
fields.description: Integer representing the assessment ID for a placement request.

fields.name: assessorTypeCode
fields.description: String representing the type of assessor involved in the assessment.

functions: Participate in interim and final assessments

workflows.name: Assessment Setup
steps: Initialize the assessment header and the wizard interface.
Load assessment sections and setup questions based on the template code.
Display assessment questions based on the section and type of assessor.
Allow navigation through different assessment steps using a wizard.

workflows.name: Assessment Finalization
steps: Submit assessments marked as either interim or final.
Generate a report of the assessment results and provide the necessary feedback.

business_rules: Assessments can be of types interim or final.
Students and instructors must complete assessments within the specified timeframe.
A question can require answers from either the student or the instructor based on the section configuration.

validations.rule: Ensure that input fields match their designated types (e.g., Text, Number, Date).

conditions.description: If an assessment section is optional and does not require assessor completion, it can be skipped.

system_behavior: Display a wizard interface for navigating assessment sections.
Display error messages and warnings based on validation results.
Read and modify data related to assessments, sections, and user sessions.
exceptions: Handle missing template codes by defaulting to a generic template.
Manage empty results by prompting for additional data entry.
